variants.name: Moonlight Vigil
variants.tooltip:
Aphelios fires a concentrated blast of moonlight that explodes when it hits a champion, dealing @MaxDamage@ physical damage to surrounding enemies.

Then, Aphelios attacks all champions hit with his main-hand weapon. {{ Spell_ApheliosR_WeaponMod_@f1@ }}
variants.tooltipExtendedBelowLine: <rules>The Attacks apply on-hits. Critical strikes deal @CritDamageModCalc@ of normal damage instead.</rules>

variants.name: The Hitman and the Seer
variants.tooltip:
Aphelios wields 5 Lunari Weapons made by his sister, Alune. He has access to two at a time: one main-hand and one off-hand. Each weapon has a unique Attack and Ability [@spell.ApheliosCalibrumQ:Hotkey@]. Attacks and Abilities consume a weapon's ammo. When out of ammo, Aphelios discards the weapon and Alune summons the next one.

Aphelios unlocks his weapon's Ability [@spell.ApheliosCalibrumQ:Hotkey@] at level 2 and his Ultimate at level 6. Instead of powering up his Abilities, Aphelios' rank-ups grant him permanent stats.

Lunari Weapon Order:

  • {{ Spell_ApheliosP_GunShortDesc_@f5@ }}
variants.tooltipExtended:
Aphelios wields 5 Lunari Weapons made by his sister Alune. He has access to two at a time: one main-hand and one off-hand. Each weapon has a unique Attack and Ability [@spell.ApheliosCalibrumQ:Hotkey@]. Attacks and Abilities consume a weapon's ammo. When out of ammo, Aphelios discards the weapon and Alune summons the next one.

Aphelios unlocks his weapon's Ability [@spell.ApheliosCalibrumQ:Hotkey@] at level 2 and his Ultimate at level 6. Instead of powering up his Abilities, Aphelios' rank-ups grant him permanent stats:
  • {{ Spell_ApheliosP_Buff_AD }} [@spell.ApheliosCalibrumQ:Hotkey@]: @spell.ApheliosP:AttackDamage@ / @AttackDamageMax@
  • {{ Spell_ApheliosP_Buff_AS }} [@spell.ApheliosW:Hotkey@]: @spell.ApheliosP:AttackSpeed@ / @AttackSpeedMax@
  • {{ Spell_ApheliosP_Buff_AP }} [@spell.ApheliosE:Hotkey@]: @spell.ApheliosP:ArPenBonus@ / @ArPenBonusMax@

stringtable.spell_apheliosq_tooltip_1: <font color='#00e6b8'><font color='#00e6b8'>Calibrum</font> <spellActive>Active:</spellActive></font> Aphelios fires a long range shot, dealing <physicalDamage>@spell.ApheliosCalibrumQ:SpellDamage@ physical damage</physicalDamage> to the first enemy hit and marking them.
stringtable.spell_apheliosq_tooltip_2: <font color='#e6005c'><font color='#e6005c'>Severum</font> <spellActive>Active:</spellActive></font> Aphelios gains <speed>@spell.ApheliosSeverumQ:Haste@ Move Speed</speed> and fires both weapons at the nearest enemy for the next @spell.ApheliosSeverumQ:Duration@ seconds. Deals <physicalDamage>@spell.ApheliosSeverumQ:TotalDamage@ physical damage</physicalDamage> over @spell.ApheliosSeverumQ:NumAttacks@ shots, prioritizing champions.
stringtable.spell_apheliosq_tooltip_3: <font color='#1a75ff'><font color='#1a75ff'>Infernum</font> <spellActive>Active:</spellActive></font> Aphelios spouts a wave of flame, dealing <physicalDamage>@spell.ApheliosInfernumQ:QWaveDamage@ physical damage</physicalDamage>. Then he Attacks each enemy hit with his off-hand weapon.
stringtable.spell_apheliosq_tooltip_4: <font color='#ffffcc'><font color='#ffffcc'>Crescendum</font> <spellActive>Active:</spellActive></font> Aphelios deploys a lunar sentry equipped with Aphelios' off-hand weapon that lasts @spell.ApheliosCrescendumQ:TurretDurationIdle@ seconds. Sentries activate when an enemy approaches and fire at them for <physicalDamage>@spell.ApheliosCrescendumQ:TurretDamage@ physical damage</physicalDamage> per shot over @spell.ApheliosCrescendumQ:TurretDurationActive@ seconds.
stringtable.spell_apheliosq_tooltip_5: <font color='#a64dff'><font color='#a64dff'>Gravitum</font> <spellActive>Active:</spellActive></font> Aphelios triggers a gravity field on enemies he has <status>Slowed</status> with <font color='#a64dff'>Gravitum</font>, <status>Rooting</status> for @spell.ApheliosGravitumQ:RootDuration@ second and dealing <magicDamage>@spell.ApheliosGravitumQ:Damage@ magic damage</magicDamage>.
stringtable.spell_apheliosq_tooltipextended_1: <font color='#00e6b8'><font color='#00e6b8'>Calibrum</font> <spellActive>Active:</spellActive></font> Aphelios fires a long range shot, dealing <physicalDamage>@spell.ApheliosCalibrumQ:SpellDamage@ physical damage</physicalDamage> to the first enemy hit and marking them.
stringtable.spell_apheliosq_tooltipextended_2:
Severum Active: Aphelios gains @spell.ApheliosSeverumQ:Haste@ Move Speed and fires both weapons at the nearest enemy for the next @spell.ApheliosSeverumQ:Duration@ seconds. Deals @spell.ApheliosSeverumQ:TotalDamage@ physical damage over @spell.ApheliosSeverumQ:NumAttacks@ shots, prioritizing champions.

Applies on-hit effects at @spell.ApheliosSeverumQ:OnHitDamageReduction@ damage.
stringtable.spell_apheliosq_tooltipextended_3: <font color='#1a75ff'><font color='#1a75ff'>Infernum</font> <spellActive>Active:</spellActive></font> Aphelios spouts a wave of flame, dealing <physicalDamage>@spell.ApheliosInfernumQ:QWaveDamage@ physical damage</physicalDamage>. Then he Attacks each enemy hit with his off-hand weapon.
stringtable.spell_apheliosq_tooltipextended_4:
Crescendum Active: Aphelios deploys a lunar sentry equipped with Aphelios' off-hand weapon that lasts @spell.ApheliosCrescendumQ:TurretDurationIdle@ seconds. Sentries activate when an enemy approaches and fire at them for @spell.ApheliosCrescendumQ:TurretDamage@ physical damage per shot over @spell.ApheliosCrescendumQ:TurretDurationActive@ seconds.

Sentries benefit from Attack Speed and Critical Strike.
stringtable.spell_apheliosq_tooltipextended_5: <font color='#a64dff'><font color='#a64dff'>Gravitum</font> <spellActive>Active:</spellActive></font> Aphelios triggers a gravity field on enemies he has <status>Slowed</status> with <font color='#a64dff'>Gravitum</font>, <status>Rooting</status> for @spell.ApheliosGravitumQ:RootDuration@ second and dealing <magicDamage>@spell.ApheliosGravitumQ:Damage@ magic damage</magicDamage>.
stringtable.spell_apheliosq_offhand_description_0: This Ability does not use Aphelios' off-hand weapon.
stringtable.spell_apheliosq_offhand_description_1: Marks targets hit by this weapon, granting vision of them. Attack marked targets from long range with your off-hand weapon. Consumes all marks for <physicalDamage>@spell.ApheliosCalibrumQ:BonusDamagePerMark@ bonus physical damage</physicalDamage> each.
stringtable.spell_apheliosq_offhand_description_2: Heals Aphelios for <healing><scaleLevel>@spell.ApheliosSeverumQ:HealAmountSpell@</scaleLevel></healing> of its damage dealt.
stringtable.spell_apheliosq_offhand_description_3: This weapon's attacks deal 110% damage and explodes into a cone.
stringtable.spell_apheliosq_offhand_description_4: Creates a mirror Chakram for each enemy hit with this weapon. These return to Aphelios and orbit around him for @spell.ApheliosCrescendumQ:MiniBuffDuration@ seconds.
stringtable.spell_apheliosq_offhand_description_5: Slows targets by @spell.ApheliosGravitumQ:SlowAmountInitial@, decaying over @spell.ApheliosGravitumQ:SlowDuration@ seconds.
stringtable.spell_apheliose_long_1:
Calibrum Passive: Aphelios gains @spell.ApheliosCalibrumQ:BonusRange@ Attack Range.

Abilities that use Calibrum mark targets for @spell.ApheliosCalibrumQ:MarkDuration@ seconds, revealing them. Aphelios can Attack a marked target from long range with his off-hand weapon, causing all nearby marks to be consumed, dealing an additional @spell.ApheliosCalibrumQ:BonusDamagePerMark@ physical damage each to the main target.
stringtable.spell_apheliose_long_2: <font color='#e6005c'><font color='#e6005c'>Severum</font> <spellPassive>Passive:</spellPassive></font> Attacks using this weapon restore <healing>@spell.ApheliosSeverumQ:HealAmount@</healing> of the damage dealt as Health, and Abilities using it restore <healing>@spell.ApheliosSeverumQ:HealAmountSpell@</healing>. This weapon can heal Aphelios over his max Health, granting him up to <shield>@spell.ApheliosSeverumQ:MaxShield@ Shield</shield>.
stringtable.spell_apheliose_long_3: <font color='#1a75ff'><font color='#1a75ff'>Infernum</font> <spellPassive>Passive:</spellPassive></font> Aphelios' Attacks deal <physicalDamage>@spell.ApheliosInfernumQ:AttackDamage@ physical damage</physicalDamage> to the primary target and <physicalDamage>@spell.ApheliosInfernumQ:SecondaryTargetPenalty@ damage</physicalDamage> to enemies behind them.
stringtable.spell_apheliose_long_4:
Crescendum Passive: Aphelios' Attacks ricochet off their target and back to Aphelios. Aphelios can Attack again immediately after he catches the ricochet.

Other Abilities that use Crescendum create mirror Chakram which each deal bonus damage when Aphelios attacks.
stringtable.spell_apheliose_long_5: <font color='#a64dff'><font color='#a64dff'>Gravitum</font></font> <spellPassive>Passive:</spellPassive> Aphelios' Attacks <status>Slow</status> targets by @spell.ApheliosGravitumQ:SlowAmountInitial@, decaying over @spell.ApheliosGravitumQ:SlowDuration@ seconds.
stringtable.apheliosgun_autoattack_tooltip_1: Increased Attack Range. Abilities that deal damage with this weapon mark the victim, granting Aphelios a bonus long-range Attack against them.
stringtable.apheliosgun_autoattack_tooltip_2: Attacks and Abilities using this weapon <healing>restore Health</healing> and can overheal you.
stringtable.apheliosgun_autoattack_tooltip_3: Attacks with this weapon deal 110% damage and explode behind the target.
stringtable.apheliosgun_autoattack_tooltip_4: Aphelios Attacks faster with this weapon the closer he is to his target and gains bonus damage on Ability hits.
stringtable.apheliosgun_autoattack_tooltip_5: Attacks with this weapon apply a decaying <status>Slow</status>.
stringtable.apheliosgun_tooltip_1: Fire a long range shot, damaging the first enemy.
stringtable.apheliosgun_tooltip_2: Move fast and continuously fire both weapons at closest enemy over @spell.ApheliosSeverumQ:Duration@ seconds.
stringtable.apheliosgun_tooltip_3: Blast flames in the target direction and Attack all enemies hit with your off-hand weapon.
stringtable.apheliosgun_tooltip_4: Deploy a sentry equipped with a copy of Aphelios' off-hand weapon that Attacks nearby enemies.
stringtable.spell_apheliose_tooltipextended_long_1:
Calibrum Passive: Aphelios gains @spell.ApheliosCalibrumQ:BonusRange@ Attack Range.

Abilities that use Calibrum mark targets for @spell.ApheliosCalibrumQ:MarkDuration@ seconds, revealing them. Aphelios can Attack a marked target from long range with his off-hand weapon, causing all nearby marks to be consumed, dealing an additional @spell.ApheliosCalibrumQ:BonusDamagePerMark@ physical damage each to the main target.

If his off-hand weapon is Calibrum, Aphelios uses his main-hand weapon instead.
stringtable.spell_apheliose_tooltipextended_long_2:
Severum Passive: Attacks using this weapon restore @spell.ApheliosSeverumQ:HealAmount@ of the damage dealt as Health, and Abilities using it restore @spell.ApheliosSeverumQ:HealAmountSpell@. This weapon can heal Aphelios over his max Health, granting him up to @spell.ApheliosSeverumQ:MaxShield@ Shield.

The Shield persists up to @spell.ApheliosSeverumQ:TotalDecayDurationForTooltip@ seconds.
stringtable.spell_apheliose_tooltipextended_long_3:
Infernum Passive: Aphelios' Attacks deal @spell.ApheliosInfernumQ:AttackDamage@ physical damage to the primary target and @spell.ApheliosInfernumQ:SecondaryTargetPenalty@ damage to enemies behind them.

Splash damage deals @spell.ApheliosInfernumQ:SecondaryMinionPenalty@ damage to minions.
stringtable.spell_apheliose_tooltipextended_long_4:
Crescendum Passive: Aphelios' Attacks ricochet off their target and back to Aphelios. Aphelios can Attack again immediately after he catches the ricochet.

Other Abilities that use Crescendum create mirror Chakram which each deal bonus damage when Aphelios attacks.

Bounce return speed increases with Attack Speed.
Chakrams can accumulate up to 20, and last for 5 seconds.
The mirror Chakram damage starts at @spell.ApheliosCrescendumQ:MiniDamageMax@ physical damage and diminishes with subsequent mirror Chakram hit (min: @spell.ApheliosCrescendumQ:MiniDamageMin@ physical damage). Duration refresh on Attacking champions. Can critically strike.
stringtable.spell_apheliose_tooltipextended_long_5: <font color='#a64dff'><font color='#a64dff'>Gravitum</font></font> <spellPassive>Passive:</spellPassive> Aphelios' Attacks <status>Slow</status> targets by @spell.ApheliosGravitumQ:SlowAmountInitial@, decaying over @spell.ApheliosGravitumQ:SlowDuration@ seconds.
stringtable.spell_apheliosr_weaponmod_1: Calibrum Bonus: Marks added this way deal an additional @CalibrumRMarkBonusDamage@ physical damage each when consumed.
stringtable.spell_apheliosr_weaponmod_2: Severum Bonus: Aphelios restores @SeverumRHealBonus@ Health.
stringtable.spell_apheliosr_weaponmod_3: Infernum Bonus: The moonlight blast deals an additional @InfernumRBonusDamage@ physical damage, and the subsequent Attacks explode, each dealing @InfernumRPenalty@ of their damage to surrounding targets.
stringtable.spell_apheliosr_weaponmod_4: Crescendum Bonus: Summons an additional @CrescendumRBonusMinis@ mirror Chakram.
stringtable.spell_apheliosr_weaponmod_5: Gravitum Bonus: Slow strength increased to @GravitumRBonusSlow@. Binding Eclipse's Root effect is increased to @GravitumRRootDuration@ seconds against these targets.
stringtable.spell_apheliosp_gunshortdesc_2: <font color='#e6005c'>Severum</font> (Scythe Pistol): Life Steal and <speed>Move Speed</speed>.
stringtable.spell_apheliosp_gunshortdesc_4: <font color='#ffffcc'>Crescendum</font> (Chakram): High damage at close range.
